text:
From Sri (the owner), word for word: "send both" (this is part 1 of 2).

Background (not Sri's own words; added so the request can be read on its own). Sri chose two fixes for the disk filling up. Each job keeps its own 15-24 GB build folder for its whole life, and with [parallel] max_concurrency = 2 two folders exist at once on a disk that fits one; the build-slot queue (max_check_slots = 1) limits builds running, not build folders kept, so the low-disk gate trips instead: jobs held, finished work discarded, and the checks-before-verifier step (D182) skipped. 14 low-disk holds this week; 6 of 12 producer passes since D182 landed skipped its checks for low disk.
Part 1, a stopgap to do now: set [parallel] max_concurrency = 1 in athena.toml, update any test that pins the repository value, and record why (until part 2 lands).
